svg.title: Metadata-driven pipelines in Microsoft Fabric
svg.desc: Fabric SQL Database stores source configuration, watermarks and object audit. The orchestrator selects ingestion requests and paginates active configurations. The Dispatcher runs a ForEach activity with bounded parallel execution within a run. An Object Controller looks up and validates each configuration before selecting a Database or File router. SQL Server tables go through a query-based Copy activity directly to Bronze. SFTP CSV files move through Binary Copy to Landing in Lakehouse Files, then a Notebook parses CSV and writes to the same Bronze Lakehouse. Both source paths support FULL and INCREMENTAL loads. This diagram is simplified and does not show audit finalization and recovery branches.
